protocol_version_id.description: The pinned ProtocolVersion. In v0.1 a GovernedContext MUST NOT be evaluated against any other ProtocolVersion.

protocol_version_hash.description: REQUIRED (added in the 2026-07 repair sprint — see 07-decisions/): sha256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical bytes of the complete pinned ProtocolVersion object (the ProtocolVersion contains no hash of itself, so the preimage is non-self-referential). Pins the exact protocol-version content, not just its id.

current_time.description: Required for any evaluation involving deadlines, durations, or lapse (CURRENT_TIME_REQUIRED).
